summary: From the black of a waste port that snaps shut, the camera pulls back to reveal red amniotic gel flowing into a pod around a tiny newborn that suckles its feed tube. Over this image, Morpheus recounts how he came to believe the truth: seeing the fields where the dead are liquefied to be fed intravenously to the living, and recognizing the horrifying precision of it. As the pull-back continues, the power-plant image is revealed to be on a television screen, and we return to the white space of the construct.

what_changes.before: He refused to believe the truth about the machines.
what_changes.after: Seeing the fields, he came to realize the obviousness of the truth.
what_changes.evidence: For the longest time, I wouldn't believe it. But then I saw the fields with my own eyes

what_changes.before: He understood the process intellectually but recoiled at it.
what_changes.after: Facing the efficiency, he accepted the horrifying precision of the system.
what_changes.evidence: facing the efficiency, the pure, horrifying precision, I came to realize the obviousness of the truth.
